targetText: Time is the room of human development. A man who has no free time to dispose of, whose whole lifetime, apart from the mere physical interruptions by sleep, meals, and so forth, is absorbed by his labour for the capitalist, is less than a beast of burden.
explanation: Marx articulates the human necessity for free time beyond work: leisure and free time are essential prerequisites for human development, education, and social fulfillment.

targetText: The slave receives a permanent and fixed amount of maintenance; the wage-labourer does not. He must try to get a rise of wages in the one instance, if only to compensate for a fall of wages in the other.
explanation: Unlike enslaved individuals whose masters must feed them regardless of market conditions, wage workers face variable market forces and must organize to defend their living standards.
